name: codex-usage-status
description: Track Codex usage and reset credits, get completion alerts, and jump back to completed chats from VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Use the path or command from Codex Executable.
Automatically use the Codex CLI bundled with the official OpenAI Codex extension.
codexUsage.codexExecutableSource.description: Select where the Codex CLI executable is loaded from.

codexUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh Codex usage in the status bar.

codexUsage.codexExecutable.description: Path or command name for the Codex CLI executable. Used when Codex Executable Source is Path.

codexUsage.showExtraBuckets.description: Show model-specific Codex usage buckets in the tooltip and Codex Usage Settings.

codexUsage.statusFormat.description: Controls the status bar text format.

codexUsage.warnAtPercent.description: Mark the status bar as warning when either primary Codex window reaches this percentage.

codexUsage.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for Codex app-server JSON-RPC requests.

codexUsage.notifyUsageWarnings.description: Notify when Codex 5-hour or 7-day usage crosses the warning threshold.

codexUsage.notifyTurnComplete.description: Notify for visible Codex turn completions, including the available chat, project, and branch identity.

codexUsage.notifyNeedsInput.description: Show notifications when Codex asks this app-server connection for user input or approval.

enumDescriptions: Use Linux desktop notifications when available, with VS Code as a fallback.
Use both Linux desktop and VS Code notifications when VS Code is unfocused.
codexUsage.notificationMode.description: Controls how Codex Usage Status delivers notifications.

enumDescriptions: Open the completed chat using the OpenAI extension's current thread resource. Experimental because this resource is not a documented public API.
